name: Skulls for Khorne
text: Each time the bearer destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, roll a D6. On a 2+ you gain 1 CP (the usual limit of one CP gained per battle round outside the Command phase still applies).

effect.name: Skulls for Khorne
effect.text: Each enemy unit the bearer wipes out in melee has a 5-in-6 chance of paying out 1 CP.

effect.name: Arch-slaughterer
effect.text: Karagar's melee weapons can pick out a visible CHARACTER inside an attached unit.
